label: Generate module documentation
instruction: Write a concise README.md in Markdown for the generated Complaint Management System (complaint_cms) module, max 90 lines. Describe the actual file structure, existing route paths (/complaints/mine, /complaints/queue, /complaints/admin and /api/v1/complaints/...) and mechanical integration setup, not requirements compliance. Explain that it uses existing Fusion auth/config/DB and that python manage.py migrate, seed_modules and client npm run build are the integration commands. State that only build/structural checks are performed in this Phase 1 one-shot local LLM trial and workflow correctness is unverified. Link evidence directory ../../docs/08-delivery/cms-qwen-trial for logs and check outputs. Return Markdown only without code fences.
